question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Final query: customer with highest average monthly change in payment amounts
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month, monthly_total,
    LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_monthly_total
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, AVG(w.monthly_total - w.prev_monthly_total) as avg_monthly_change
FROM with_prev w
JOIN customer c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE w.prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1

{"sql": "-- Compute average monthly change per customer
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month, monthly_total,
    LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_monthly_total
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT customer_id, AVG(monthly_total - prev_monthly_total) as avg_monthly_change
FROM with_prev
WHERE prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 10", "preview_rows": 10}

-- Final query: customer with highest average monthly change in payment amounts
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month, SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month, monthly_total,
    LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_monthly_total
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, AVG(w.monthly_total - w.prev_monthly_total) as avg_monthly_change
FROM with_prev w
JOIN customer c ON w.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE w.prev_monthly_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
